style: Warm, soft children's book illustration with gentle lighting, realistic but friendly African setting
subject: Five happy Ugandan children playing together in a village setting
details: Five African children of different ages (2-6 years) playing together in a village compound. Mix of boys and girls wearing colorful East African clothing. prompt: Children's book illustration, warm golden afternoon light. Five happy African children aged 2-6 playing together in a Ugandan village compound. Realistic but child-friendly style, warm inviting scene full of joy and energy.
